label: NATIVE (ODG GO dispatch, REPLAY-1 of RUN-1's ODG-generated candidates)

rules.sample: SAMPLE-1: n candidates drawn in order from a PRE-DECLARED schedule of (model, temperature, seed) points; a schedule point not in spec.points is refused before any call; n ≤ |schedule|; every candidate records its point + sha256 of its output
rules.select: XSEL-2 (V19 P1-R, revision 2): X = XSEL-1 ranking over ALL candidates (TAMPER-1 excluded → visible passes desc → compileOk desc → codeLines asc → sha256 asc); M = the candidates tied at X's top visible-pass count; each member of M gets its signature vector over probes derived from VISIBLE args only (a member whose probe run is not measurable forms its OWN singleton cluster — never dropped); clusters by identical vector; if |M| ≤ 1, a single cluster (unanimous ⇒ no information) or a tie for the largest cluster ⇒ X's choice; else the strictly largest cluster wins and, within it, the member with the best X rank (candidate id / schedule position never decisive); hidden cases never consulted
rules.controlSelect: XSEL-1 (selection independent of generation): exclude TAMPER-1 candidates → visible-case passes desc (sandbox-executed, visible cases ONLY) → compileOk desc (strict typecheck / parse) → codeLines asc → sha256 asc (content tie-break; candidate id and schedule position are never decisive); no model self-assessment; hidden cases never consulted
rules.host: HOST-1: loadavg-1m and nproc are recorded before EVERY model call (warm-up included); the run refuses to START (NOT_MEASURED, no model call) when loadavg-1m > nproc×idleFactor. A later reading above the threshold is recorded (hostLoadAboveThreshold) but does not stop the run: the model server's own inference raises loadavg-1m, so a mid-run reading cannot separate ODG's load from a concurrent one
rules.adapt: ADAPT-1: estimateMs = 1000·(ceil(promptChars/charsPerToken)/promptTokPerS + numPredict/genTokPerS) from ONE warm-up call on the same model; timeoutMs = clamp(ceil(safetyFactor·estimateMs) + overheadMs, minMs, maxMs); estimateMs > maxMs ⇒ the call is NOT sent (NOT_MEASURED: the cap cannot cover the predicted duration)

split.rule: VIS-1: visible = even case indices (0, 2, 4, …); hidden = odd indices; acceptance = ALL cases (host-graded)
VIS-1: visible = even case indices (0, 2, 4, …); hidden = odd indices; acceptance = ALL cases (host-graded)
